title: recording.segment.completed payload
description: Emitted by RIM when a recorder's file has been handed over and has become an ingest job (EP-39; ADR-0007), in the transaction that creates the job. One per file part: a capture continued after a crash is part 2, 3, … of the same file.

jobId.description: The ingest job the file became.

fileStart.description: The start of the part of the recording this file IS — a grid slot, clipped to the window. The file itself starts up to the recorder's pad earlier.

part.description: 1 for a file captured whole; 2, 3, … for a continuation after a crash.

partial.description: The capture did not run to the end of its span — it was cut by a crash. The file is kept (ADR-0007 decision 3).

startedAt.description: When the capture started, by the worker's clock.
